For the N.H.A.I. : Mr. S. N. Pathak, Adv.
 : Mr. Saurav Nikunj, Adv.
Oral Order

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the National Highways Authority of India and learned counsel for the State.
2. Counsel for the petitioner has filed the present Writ petition for grant of compensation which is four times the rate of the land, as no compensation has been granted to the petitioner with regard to the land bearing khata no. 161, khesra Patna High Court CWJC No.1600 of 2020(11) dt.20-06-2023 688, thana no. 357, area 22 decimal (0.089 hectare) acquired vide notification dated 29.03.2012, by the respondent for the construction of National Highway No. 77.
Prabhu Narayan Thakur, vs The Union Of India on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/170015480/
1 3.
Counsel for the petitioner submits that award has not been prepared in the name of the petitioner, though the payment of compensation in part has been made, which he has received.

Counsel submits that the other similarly situated persons have been granted compensation,
according to the new law of Right To Fair Compensation And Transparency In Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation And Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text:
Right To Fair Compensation And Transparency In Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation And Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: He also submits that in his case no compensation has been made.

4. Counsel for State submits that award has been prepared and payable amount has been served being panchat no. 25 in the name of three persons Mosmat Anandi Devi, Virender Mohan Thakur and petitioner Prabhu Narayan Thakur, which is apparent from Annexure-A to the counter-affidavit.

5. Counsel for National Highways Authority of India submits that once award has been prepared then according to Section 3 G(5) of the N.H. Act, 1956 the remedy is available to the petitioner before the arbitrator that for all his grievances, he ought to move before the arbitrator under the Act.
Here in the present case, the said person is the Commissioner, Muzaffarpur.
Patna High Court CWJC No.1600 of 2020(11) dt.20-06-2023 6.

In this background, this petitioner is directed to file his statement of claim before the Commissioner, Muzaffarpur- cum-Aarbitrator under N.H. Act, 1956 raising all his grievances raised in the Writ petition, within four weeks from today.
7.
With the aforesaid direction, this writ petition is hereby disposed off.

(Dr. Anshuman, J.) Ashishsingh/-
